title: Turn acting-character attribution
description: Record and honor which PC is acting on a turn. RunTurnInput.playerInput has no notion of the acting PC and the turn trace does not record one. Add RunTurnInput.actingCharacterId (defaults to meta.active_character_id), thread it into ToolContext so mutation tools default to the acting PC, and persist it on the turn trace for replay/audit. Acceptance: a turn can name an acting PC distinct from the active PC; tools default to it; trace records the acting PC; defaults to active when omitted; tests cover default and explicit cases.
close_reason: ToolContext + RunTurnInput actingCharacterId; tools default to acting PC, assembler renders acting PC sheet, both fall back to active. 3 unit tests. biome+typecheck clean; only pre-existing dolt-subprocess timeouts flake under parallel load (see memory dolt-checkpoint-tests-flaky-under-parallel-load). Committed 7ca546c.
